text: Los alcaldes quieren sus trenes. Hacienda quiere su dinero. Y yo quiero un titular para el telediario de las tres. ¿Qué ponemos primero? Piénsalo rápido, que tengo una inauguración.
claim: Asks for the first priority: public service/coverage or commercial discipline. Implies the choice shapes how the company is financed and run.
trigger: Campaign mode only: engine.js:155 pendingDecision returns DECISIONS.find(d=>s.month>=d.at&&!s.decided.includes(d.id)) with at=0 (January 2022); in free mode pendingDecision returns before DECISIONS, so it never plays there. Modal showDecision app.js:1171-1175; step() refuses to advance while it is pending (engine.js:209); a choice whose cash cost exceeds s.cash is disabled (app.js:1174). Effects run in decide→applyEffects (engine.js:163-179). It is the first modal of a new campaign (beginCampaign → showDecision, app.js:1164-1165); the guided turn starts after it (app.js:1296).
choiceEffects: 'Servicio público': cash +120, reputation +5, s.policy='public'. 'Disciplina comercial': cash +160, reputation −3, s.policy='commercial' (engine.js:164-166). s.policy is read every month: non-AVE subsidy = trainKm×(public 2.2 : commercial 1.6)/1e6+0.04 (engine.js:66), plus a base subsidy of 3.5 vs 2 M€/month (engine.js:73). Nothing else writes s.policy (free mode keeps 'public').
why: The choice persists and is read by balance() every month, and the +120/+160 M€ match the details. Weak points: the priority only changes subsidies, not demand, requests or trust groups, and the induction quiz «mandate» asks the same thing without any effect.
unifiedFix: Keep it as the opening decision. s.policy should drive (a) the PSO subsidy per train-km on non-AVE services (2.2 vs 1.6 €/train-km) and the base transfer (3.5 vs 2 M€/month), (b) starting trust (+10 Territorio for public, +10 Hacienda for commercial), and (c) which contract branch is offered first. Merge the induction «mandate» quiz into this stored policy. The text is date-free, so it works in any unified start year.

text: La factura eléctrica de este año trae más ceros que un fichaje de verano. O pagamos un seguro de precio, o rezamos. Te adelanto el final: las dos opciones duelen, y la segunda, más.
claim: This year the electricity bill is huge. Pay for price insurance or pray. Both options hurt, and the second hurts more.
trigger: Campaign mode only: engine.js:155 pendingDecision returns DECISIONS.find(d=>s.month>=d.at&&!s.decided.includes(d.id)) with at=2 (March 2022); in free mode pendingDecision returns before DECISIONS, so it never plays there. Modal showDecision app.js:1171-1175; step() refuses to advance while it is pending (engine.js:209); a choice whose cash cost exceeds s.cash is disabled (app.js:1174). Effects run in decide→applyEffects (engine.js:163-179).
choiceEffects: 'Contratar cobertura': cash −24 and flag 'hedge'=month+12. Nothing ever reads 'hedge' (grep: no reader). 'Que sea lo que Dios quiera': flag 'energy'=month+12, so metrics multiplies the energy term m.energy×2.8 per train-km by 1.22 (engine.js:64, 167). Simulated at month 0, the whole network's energy term is 1.48 M€/month, so the +22 % costs about 0.33 M€/month, about 3.9 M€ for the year.
why: Insurance costs 24 M€ against about 3.9 M€ of extra energy cost, so «la segunda, más» is false by a factor of about 6. There is no energy price in the state, the hedge flag is dead, and the surcharge exists only for players who refuse the hedge.
unifiedFix: Add an energy price index to the state, with separate indices for electric traction (25 kV / 3 kV) and diesel (S730 and diesel regionals). A dated 2022 spike (+60–80 % for 12 months) hits everyone. Energy cost per train-km = model energy factor × index. «Contratar cobertura» locks the pre-crisis index for 12 months. Its premium is computed and displayed as about 50 % of the projected exposure (0.5 × 12 × monthly energy bill × spike), so refusing really costs more in expectation. The text can stay.

With «Delegar mes» it is still untrue at that moment (sim: madrid-burgos AVE not feasible). The launch campaign changes no demand.

Fix gameDate so history applies on its real day. «Campaña de lanzamiento» becomes a route-scoped marketing modifier: +10 % demand on every service ending at or passing through Burgos for 6 months. If the unified game starts in 2027, play this as backstory or drop it.

text: El Gobierno regala descuentos para viajar en tren y media España ha descubierto que existe el Alvia. Puedes reforzar el servicio con ayuda extraordinaria, o encomendarte a la Virgen del Pilar y que los viajeros vayan de pie.

trigger: Campaign mode only: engine.js:155 pendingDecision returns DECISIONS.find(d=>s.month>=d.at&&!s.decided.includes(d.id)) with at=8 (September 2022); in free mode pendingDecision returns before DECISIONS, so it never plays there. choiceEffects: 'Reforzar los Alvia': cash +65, reputation +4, flag 'passes' for 18 months, so demand ×1.15 on every non-AVE service (engine.js:53, 167). 'Ir tirando': cash +25, reputation −2, no flag. Neither choice changes frequency, units or capacity.
why: The demand surge exists only if you pay for the reinforcement; refusing makes it vanish instead of leaving people standing. «Reforzar» adds no trains and pays +65 M€ for nothing. Without extra capacity, the +15 % is clipped by capacity (engine.js:61-62). At month 8 only 3 non-AVE services run (santander, pamplona, badajoz).
unifiedFix: Make the passes an exogenous shock: +15 % demand on Alvia and regional services for 18 months, whatever the player chooses. «Reforzar» becomes a 65 M€ grant tied to a plan: add ≥1 departure per direction on N Alvia services, or lease or buy units on Trenespop, within 3 months; otherwise the grant is clawed back. Demand above capacity counts as standing passengers (satisfaction penalty when load > 100 %) and leaks to buses. «Ir tirando»: +25 M€, no reinforcement, and the crowding penalty applies.

'Mirar hacia otro lado': reputation −2.

text: Cuarenta y cinco grados en Córdoba, lo que allí llaman una tarde fresquita. La vía se dilata, la catenaria se descuelga y los viajeros se derriten. Hay que reforzar el mantenimiento. Ahorrar ahora puede salir carísimo luego, y luego me toca a mí dar explicaciones.

unifiedFix: Trigger in June–August (or right after a heatwave event) from 2030 on. Without a plan, every summer caps vmax by about 30 km/h on hot southern tramos and adds heat incidents. «Plan de resiliencia» is a permanent asset: heat caps and incidents on those tramos are halved. «Reducir la oferta» really cuts frequency by 20 % on corridors via Córdoba, Sevilla or Badajoz for the summer: revenue lost, reputation −4, punctuality kept.

It lists rural routes (the arc 3 cities in tycoon.js:54 — sal, bad, sor, lug, fer, avi, jae, hue, alg — plus Teruel) with a minimum frequency (≥2 per direction) and punctuality ≥80 %. unifiedFix: Keep, but model a global factory backlog when this happens: +8 months on all factory lead times for 18 months, for everyone. «Reservar capacidad» exempts the player (−6 months versus baseline) for 36 months and pulls already-signed, undelivered orders forward by 6 months. text: Esta noche se han llevado tres kilómetros de cable de señalización. Profesionales, oiga: ni una pieza de más. Podemos reponerlo deprisa y pagar el doble, o hacerlo a nuestro ritmo, que ya sabe usted cuál es.

trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months. choiceEffects: 'Reponer ya': −9 M€, reputation +1. 'A nuestro ritmo': flag 'strike' for 2 months, reliability −10 on ALL services (engine.js:54, 167).
why: No tramo is affected; the penalty reuses the strike flag across the whole network. The daily «Robo de cable» signal incident (operations.js:43) is unrelated and stays random.
unifiedFix: Pick a real signalled tramo used by active services and give it a signal-fault state: vmax −30 % plus extra signal incidents on trips crossing it until repaired. «Reponer ya» repairs it in 1 week for 9 M€; «A nuestro ritmo» repairs it in 8 weeks for free. Only routes using the tramo lose punctuality and revenue.

text: Los maquinistas han convocado huelga. Dicen que llevan diez años esperando el convenio. Yo llevo treinta esperando una llave inglesa que no esté doblada, y aquí sigo. Usted verá si negocia o si aguanta.

trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). choiceEffects: 'Negociar el convenio': −20 M€, reputation +3; no wage change and no staff trust change. 'Aguantar el pulso': reputation −4 and flag 'strike' for 1 month (reliability −10). No minimum services: servicePlan and capacity are unchanged.
why: «servicios mínimos un mes» is not implemented: trips and seats are unchanged. The strike ignores Plantilla trust, and negotiation changes neither payroll nor trust.
unifiedFix: Trigger when groups.staff < 35, more likely as trust falls. «Negociar»: permanent +3 % driver cost and staff trust +20. «Aguantar»: for 4 weeks staffing is capped at minimum services (0.5 on AVE, 0.75 on PSO), with real lost revenue and satisfaction, staff trust −10 and a repeat-strike risk.

text: Le habla Marisa Andén, de los viajeros. El wifi de sus trenes va a la velocidad de un burro cansado, y los enchufes, cuando funcionan, dan calambre. Un influencer con dos millones de seguidores lo ha grabado. Enhorabuena: es usted tendencia.
claim: Onboard wifi is as slow as a tired donkey and the sockets shock you. An influencer filmed it.
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). choiceEffects: 'Wifi nuevo en toda la flota': −14 M€ and a one-off satisfaction +5, which decays through the monthly smoothing s.satisfaction×0.84 + target×0.16 (engine.js:213). It does not enable the wifi policy or add quality. 'Pedir paciencia': reputation −3.
why: The fix is a one-off bump that fades within months and is unrelated to the existing wifi policy. The complaint can arrive while free wifi is already active.
unifiedFix: Fire only if the wifi policy is off, or the average fleet condition is low. «Wifi nuevo» is 14 M€ capex that sets a per-lot wifi attribute: +3 quality permanently on those units, and new Trenespop units come with it. Alternatively, it enables the wifi policy free of charge for 2 years.

text: Bruselas manda dinero para electrificar y modernizar vías, y hay que gastarlo antes de que se den cuenta de que no tenemos proyectos. Durante dos años, tus obras de catenaria y de ancho saldrán un cuarenta por ciento más baratas. No te acostumbres.

why: Exactly as stated: catenary and gauge works (plus renewals and changers) are quoted at 60 % for 24 months.
unifiedFix: Keep. Tie it to a historical EU window (NextGenerationEU 2021–2026) or a call deadline; the discount is locked when the contract is signed. Include voltage-conversion works (3 → 25 kV) once they exist.

text: Mala noticia: este año no hay presupuestos, y sin presupuestos no hay alegrías. Te retengo una parte de las transferencias. No me mires así, que yo solo soy la de la tijera.
claim: No budget this year, so part of the transfers is withheld.
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months, from month 12. Shown by pendingDecision (engine.js:155) in campaign and free mode, after any pending dated decision. Effects in applyEffects (engine.js:163-174).
choiceEffects: 'Aceptarlo': −30 M€. 'Protestar en la prensa': −12 M€, reputation −3. Both are one-off cash; subsidies are unchanged. Because both choices cost cash, when cash < 12 both buttons are disabled (app.js:1174), Esc is blocked (app.js:1451) and step() will not run (engine.js:209): a softlock. Verified: with cash 5 both decide() calls throw.
why: A withheld transfer is modelled as a lump sum, not as a reduced monthly transfer, and the event can softlock a company that is short of cash.
unifiedFix: Model state transfers as a monthly line (base 3.5/2 M€ plus PSO per train-km). The freeze cuts it by 30 % for 12 months (≈30 M€ over the year). «Protestar» cuts only 12 % but costs Gobierno trust −10 and reputation −3. Never require cash up front. Trigger only in budget or election years (after an early election, or the year after an ELECTIONS week).

text: Me he encadenado a la vía de mi pueblo y de aquí no me muevo hasta que llegue el AVE. Bueno, me muevo para comer, que tengo una edad. Pero vuelvo. ¿Qué va a hacer usted?
claim: A mayor has chained himself to the track until the AVE arrives. What will you do?
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months. Shown by pendingDecision (engine.js:155) in campaign and free mode, after any pending dated decision. Effects in applyEffects (engine.js:163-174). No specific town and no request is created.
choiceEffects: 'Prometerle un estudio': −3 M€, reputation +2. 'Ignorarlo': reputation −3. No request, study object or follow-up.
why: No town is identified and no 'ave' request is created, although the request system already supports type 'ave' (engine.js:243-251). The promised study does not exist.
unifiedFix: Pick a real city served only by Alvia, from the same pool generateRequest uses for 'ave' (engine.js:249-251). «Prometer un estudio» creates a tracked study (3 M€, 6 months). When it ends, it unlocks a costed LAV or gauge-conversion quote for that city and an 'ave' request (36 months, reward 30–55 M€). «Ignorarlo»: Territorio −5, and the mayor comes back.

text: Buenos días, competidor. Le aviso por cortesía: Autocares Meseta saca billetes a cinco euros a todas sus ciudades. Con wifi que funciona, por cierto. Que tenga usted un buen día, si puede.
claim: Autocares Meseta is selling five-euro tickets to all your cities, with working wifi.
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months. Shown by pendingDecision (engine.js:155) in campaign and free mode, after any pending dated decision. Effects in applyEffects (engine.js:163-174). It is independent of the automatic bus price war every 18 months (engine.js:230).
choiceEffects: 'Bajar tarifas un tiempo': −10 M€, reputation +2. No player fare is lowered and the bus price does not fall. 'Confiar en la velocidad': flag buswar for 6 months, bus fare ×0.78 (engine.js:57). Madrid–Barcelona bus ≈41 € → 32 €, never 5 €.
why: The announced rival price cut happens only if you pick option 2, and it is −22 %, not 5 €. Option 1 neither cuts your fares nor counters the bus; it pays 10 M€ to make the announcement untrue.
unifiedFix: Make the bus war a state of the bus rival. On this event, bus fares on all corridors drop to max(5 €, 0.03 €/km) for 6 months whatever the player does. «Bajar tarifas» applies −15 % to the player's fares on routes under 400 km for 6 months: real revenue loss, share protected. «Confiar en la velocidad» keeps fares and loses share where the train's time advantage is small. Merge the periodic automatic war into this event.

text: Los carriles están a sesenta grados y se dilatan más que el presupuesto de una obra. Hay que limitar velocidades o arriesgarse a que la vía haga una ese. Usted decide. Yo, por si acaso, me pongo el casco.
claim: Rails at 60 °C expand. Limit speeds, or risk the track buckling.
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months, only in June–August (months [5,6,7]). Shown by pendingDecision (engine.js:155) in campaign and free mode, after any pending dated decision. Effects in applyEffects (engine.js:163-174).
choiceEffects: 'Patrullas y riego de vía': −8 M€. 'Limitar velocidades': flag heat for 2 months, reliability −5. No speed limit is applied; trip times are unchanged.
why: The season is right and the choice detail («peor puntualidad») is true, but speeds are never limited and patrols only avoid the flag. The daily «Ola de calor» weather incidents (operations.js:162) are independent.
unifiedFix: «Limitar velocidades» caps vmax on hot-region tramos for 8 weeks (160 km/h on conventional lines, −20 % on LAV), so trip times rise and share falls. «Patrullas» costs 8 M€ and avoids the cap but keeps a small buckling-incident risk. Link it to the climate decision's resilience plan.

text: Ha nevado en la meseta como no se recuerda, y la catenaria se ha congelado en tres puertos. Las máquinas quitanieves están en camino. Una de ellas lleva desde el año pasado en camino, pero esa es otra historia.
claim: Record snow on the Meseta; the catenary is frozen on three mountain passes.
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months, only in December–February (months [0,1,11]). Shown by pendingDecision (engine.js:155) in campaign and free mode, after any pending dated decision. Effects in applyEffects (engine.js:163-174).
choiceEffects: 'Movilizar todo': −10 M€, reputation +2. 'Esperar al deshielo': reputation −1 and flag heat for 1 month, reliability −5 network-wide.
why: The season matches, but frozen catenary is not modelled: electric trains keep crossing the passes. The penalty is a generic network-wide punctuality hit.
unifiedFix: Choose up to 3 electrified mountain tramos (Pajares leo-pol, Padornelo mfl-our, the Guadarrama/Somosierra lines) and remove their power for 2 weeks. Electric trains cannot route there (fault 'elec'); hybrids (S730, Dörfler BMU) pass in diesel at ≤160 km/h. «Movilizar todo» shortens the outage to 3 days for 10 M€.

text: Un rebaño de vacas ha decidido pastar en la vía. Llevan media hora mirando al Alvia y el Alvia las mira a ellas. Nadie cede. Yo propongo esperar, que las vacas tienen más paciencia que nosotros.

trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). unifiedFix: Add a per-tramo 'fenced' flag. «Vallar» fences the single-track rural tramos (track 'unica' in segments.json) and permanently halves trespass and animal incidents on them. «Que se aparten» causes one 40-minute delay incident on a rural route this week.

text: Un operador extranjero se deshace de unos trenes de alta velocidad casi nuevos. Bueno, casi nuevos: tienen algún arañazo y huelen a queso. Si los quiere, son suyos a buen precio. Yo los arreglo.

trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). why: You really get 4 AVE at 80 % for 60 M€. New ones cost 100 M€ with a 30-month lead (purchaseQuote, sim). It matches a Trenespop used s112 lot at 80 % condition (factor 0.30 + 80×0.0035 = 0.58 × 25 M€ × 4 ≈ 58 M€), so it duplicates Trenespop.
unifiedFix: Make it a Trenespop flash listing: «Operador extranjero», 4× S112-class (Tardo, 25 kV, standard gauge), 80 %, immediate delivery, 60 M€, expiring in 4 weeks. Voltage and gauge compatibility checks and resale then apply. The dialogue opens the listing.

text: Se ha quemado una nave del taller. No ha habido heridos, solo un bocadillo de chorizo y mi orgullo. Necesito dinero para arreglarlo, o tendremos los trenes peor cuidados unos meses.
claim: A workshop bay has burned down. Pay to rebuild it, or trains will be worse maintained for a few months.
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months. Shown by pendingDecision (engine.js:155) in campaign and free mode, after any pending dated decision. Effects in applyEffects (engine.js:163-174).
choiceEffects: 'Reconstruir ya': −18 M€. 'Apañarse': fleetDamage 6, so every lot loses 6 condition at once, floor 15 (engine.js:169).
why: The consequence is an instant one-off condition drop, not «unos meses» of worse maintenance, and the game has no workshop capacity.
unifiedFix: Model workshop capacity. «Apañarse» sets the maintenance multiplier to 0.85 for 6 months: wear +50 % and refits +2 months. «Reconstruir» (18 M€) keeps it at 1.0.

text: Un tren suyo ha llegado puntual y un viajero lo ha grabado: lleva tres millones de visitas. Es lo más visto del día, por delante de un perro que habla. No sé si felicitarle o preocuparme.
claim: One of your trains arrived on time, a passenger filmed it, and it went viral.
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months. Shown by pendingDecision (engine.js:155) in campaign and free mode, after any pending dated decision. Effects in applyEffects (engine.js:163-174). Punctuality is never checked.
choiceEffects: 'Aprovechar el tirón': −5 M€ and flag hype for 6 months, AVE demand ×1.1 (engine.js:53). 'Disfrutarlo en silencio': reputation +2.
why: The effect is real, but the premise is never checked: the event can fire in a month with 50 % punctuality.
unifiedFix: Trigger only if some route reached ≥95 % punctuality last turn (or a busy-route trip ran with zero delay). The hype applies to that route: +10 % for 6 months.

text: Este verano hay fiestas, ferias, conciertos y romerías en media España. Bueno, como todos los veranos, pero este año la gente viaja más. Si pone trenes, se llenan. Si no, se llenan los autobuses de ese señor tan simpático del asfalto.
claim: Summer festivals everywhere and people travel more. Add trains and they fill up; if not, the buses do.
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months, only in June–July (months [5,6]). Shown by pendingDecision (engine.js:155) in campaign and free mode, after any pending dated decision. Effects in applyEffects (engine.js:163-174).
choiceEffects: 'Refuerzo de verano': −8 M€ and flag tourism for 3 months, demand ×1.1 on every route (engine.js:53). No capacity is added. 'Lo de siempre': nothing, not even the demand rise.
why: Extra travel happens only if you pay, and paying adds no trains, so wherever capacity binds the extra demand is lost anyway.
unifiedFix: Demand +10 % for 3 months regardless of the choice. «Refuerzo de verano» adds a temporary departure per direction on the N busiest services, using spare units and drivers (operating costs + 8 M€). Without it, demand above capacity goes to the bus (Autocares Meseta share rises).

text: El Tribunal de Cuentas quiere revisar tus gastos. Todo en orden, ¿verdad? Claro que sí. Por si acaso, pon un abogado bueno o paga una consultora que nos diga lo que queremos oír.
claim: The Court of Audit wants to review your spending. Hire a consultancy, or trust your accounts.
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months, from month 18. Shown by pendingDecision (engine.js:155) in campaign and free mode, after any pending dated decision. Effects in applyEffects (engine.js:163-174).
choiceEffects: 'Consultora de prestigio': −7 M€, reputation +2. 'Confiar en la contabilidad': 55 % gamble, reputation +3 or −20 M€ and reputation −4 (engine.js:172). With cash < 20, the bad branch throws in spend() after the draw (engine.js:164), and act() keeps the advanced seed (app.js:184-187), so the player can re-roll until winning. Sim: 300/300 wins with cash 10, versus 160/300 with cash 100.
why: The outcome is a coin flip unrelated to the real accounts (losses, debt, corruption), and it is exploitable when cash is low.
unifiedFix: Derive the risk from state: P(bad) = f(negative months in the last 12, debt/cash, Rescate corruption flags such as 'bribes' and 'audit'). Resolve atomically with a fixed per-event seed (no re-roll). A bad result means a fine and Hacienda trust −.

text: En una de sus obras han aparecido restos romanos. Una calzada, un mosaico y lo que parece una moneda de Trajano. Precioso, pero los arqueólogos tienen prioridad. Calcule unos meses de retraso. O pague y lo hacemos de noche, con linternas.
claim: Roman remains have appeared in one of your works. Pay night shifts, or accept several months of delay.
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months, only when a non-upgrade work is unfinished (needsWorks, engine.js:159-160). Shown by pendingDecision (engine.js:155) in campaign and free mode, after any pending dated decision. Effects in applyEffects (engine.js:163-174).
choiceEffects: 'Pagar turnos de noche': −12 M€. 'Esperar a los arqueólogos': worksDelay +4, so ALL unfinished non-upgrade works get +4 months (engine.js:170).
why: The precondition is right, but the delay hits every work, not «una de sus obras».
unifiedFix: Pick one unfinished work and delay only that one by 4 months. Show its name on the dialogue card, not in the recorded text.

text: No se lo va a creer, pero una de sus obras va adelantada. Lo he comprobado tres veces. Si pone un poco más de dinero, terminamos antes y nos hacemos una foto, que no pasa todos los días.
claim: One of your works is ahead of schedule. Put in a bit more money and it finishes early.
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months, only when works are in progress (needsWorks). Shown by pendingDecision (engine.js:155) in campaign and free mode, after any pending dated decision. Effects in applyEffects (engine.js:163-174).
choiceEffects: 'Acelerar': −15 M€ and worksDelay −3, so ALL unfinished non-upgrade works finish 3 months earlier (never before next month, engine.js:170). 'Ir a su ritmo': none.
why: It accelerates every work, not one, and nothing checks that a work is really ahead. The 22 % random overrun roll at completion (engine.js:226) can still add months.
unifiedFix: Select one work with progress ≥50 % and no delay. Apply −3 months only to it and skip its overrun roll; the price scales with the work cost (≈10 %).

text: Viene un jefe de Estado extranjero y quiere viajar en AVE. Que vea lo mejor que tenemos, y que no vea lo demás. Si todo sale bien, la foto es mía. Si sale mal, la culpa es tuya, como siempre.
claim: A foreign head of state wants to travel by AVE. Run an immaculate special train, or let them travel like everyone else.
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months, from month 4. Shown by pendingDecision (engine.js:155) in campaign and free mode, after any pending dated decision. Effects in applyEffects (engine.js:163-174).
choiceEffects: 'Tren especial impecable': −6 M€, reputation +4. 'Que viaje como todo el mundo': 50 % gamble, reputation ±5.
why: The trip's outcome is a coin flip, independent of punctuality or fleet condition on the AVE lines.
unifiedFix: Use the best AVE route: the chance of a good trip is its punctuality last turn, adjusted by lot condition (92 % punctual means 92 %). The special train needs a free AVE unit.

text: He convocado elecciones, que me apetecía. Necesito inaugurar algo ya, lo que sea, aunque sea un apeadero o una máquina de café. Dame algo que cortar con unas tijeras grandes.
claim: I have called elections. I need to inaugurate something now. Give me something to cut with big scissors.
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months, from month 20. Shown by pendingDecision (engine.js:155) in campaign and free mode, after any pending dated decision. Effects in applyEffects (engine.js:163-174). The classic engine has no election state.
choiceEffects: 'Inaugurar lo que haya': −10 M€, reputation +4; nothing checks that anything was finished. 'No hay nada que cortar': reputation −3. «El presidente toma nota» is not implemented: groups.government is untouched (decide only changes groups for encounters, engine.js:177).
why: There are no elections, nothing to inaugurate is checked, and the president's «note» has no effect.
unifiedFix: Use the Rescate election calendar (ELECTIONS = [208, 416], rescate-data.js:8; electionForecast rescate.js:1029 and election() rescate.js:1128-1136), plus snap elections. Fire 8–12 weeks before an election. «Inaugurar» is available only if a work or a service opening finished in the last 12 weeks, or will before election day: Gobierno trust +10, vote +1. Otherwise «No hay nada que cortar»: Gobierno trust −8, plus an inauguration commitment.

text: Anoche le contesté a un señor que se quejaba de un retraso. Y luego a otro. Y luego a su cuñado. Ahora todo el país habla de nuestros trenes. Bien o mal, no lo sé, pero hablan. Necesito que esta semana todo funcione.
claim: The minister answered complaints on Twitter at three in the morning; now the whole country is talking about our trains. Everything must work this week.
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months, from month 22 (November 2023, when the successor becomes minister). Shown by pendingDecision (engine.js:155) in campaign and free mode, after any pending dated decision. Effects in applyEffects (engine.js:163-174).
choiceEffects: 'Refuerzo de puntualidad': −8 M€ and a one-off satisfaction +3. 'Que se pase solo': reputation −2. Nothing measures the week.
why: «Necesito que esta semana todo funcione» is never measured, and the paid fix is a satisfaction bump that decays.
unifiedFix: Create a 1-week challenge: punctuality ≥90 % next turn. «Refuerzo» switches the operating priority to 'punctual' (operations.js:125: −4 min per delay, 0.009 M€/day) and adds standby crews. Success gives reputation +3; failure gives Gobierno trust −5.

text: Le recuerdo, por si se le había olvidado, que Teruel existe. Y Soria. Y mi pueblo, aunque eso lo sabemos los de siempre. Queremos tren decente, con catenaria y sin gasóleo. ¿Lo pone usted o se lo pido a los Reyes Magos?
claim: Teruel exists. We want a decent train, with catenary and no diesel. Will you provide it?
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months. Shown by pendingDecision (engine.js:155) in campaign and free mode, after any pending dated decision. Effects in applyEffects (engine.js:163-174). It fires even after zar-ter and ter-sag have been electrified.
choiceEffects: 'Prometer catenaria': −4 M€, reputation +3; nothing is tracked. 'Pedirle paciencia': reputation −2.
why: The promise has no state and is unrelated to the real works (Zaragoza–Teruel 86 M€ / 31 months, Teruel–Sagunt 64 M€ / 26 months). The event can fire once Teruel is already electrified, which would contradict it.
unifiedFix: Precondition: zar-ter or ter-sag still has e:'no'. «Prometer catenaria» creates a commitment to start electrifying a Teruel tramo within 12 months; choose the voltage (3 kV matches Sagunt–València; 25 kV is cheaper per km). Breach: Territorio −15 and the mayor comes back. Completion: Territorio +10.

text: Los viajeros ya no saben dónde meter las maletas. Hay maletas en los pasillos, en los baños y una en el techo, no me pregunte cómo. Podría reformar los coches, o seguir jugando al tetris.
claim: Passengers no longer know where to put their suitcases. Refit the racks, or keep playing tetris.
trigger: Random event: rollEvent (engine.js:157-162), called by step() after each month close (engine.js:229). It needs s.month>=3, campaign month<346, a 32 % roll (random>.32 means no event), and the id not seen in the last 30 months. Shown by pendingDecision (engine.js:155) in campaign and free mode, after any pending dated decision. Effects in applyEffects (engine.js:163-174).
choiceEffects: 'Reformar portaequipajes': −10 M€, satisfaction +3. 'Seguir con el tetris': satisfaction −2.
why: A small comfort decision with exactly the stated satisfaction effects; it promises nothing more.
unifiedFix: Optional: the refit adds +1 quality on long-distance lots for 5 years, and the event fires more often when occupancy is above 85 %.

text: Enhorabuena por el cargo, que es precioso: todo el mundo sabe hacerlo mejor que tú. Te dejo media flota parada y dos anchos de vía que no se hablan desde mil ochocientos cuarenta y ocho. Pon trenes, atiende a los alcaldes, que llamarán, y encarga material sin vaciar la caja. Yo lo venderé en rueda de prensa como un éxito. Tú encárgate de que lo sea, que para eso cobras.
claim: Half the fleet is idle and two gauges do not talk to each other. Run trains, attend the mayors who will call, and order rolling stock without emptying the cash.
trigger: Campaign only. Shown on the Despacho story page while s.chapter=0 (storyPage app.js:959-967; free mode renders a different page). choiceEffects: No choices. Objectives (story.js:15): 12 active services, 2 city requests, 2 refurbished trains, 2 trains ordered. Reward 100 M€ and reputation +5 (engine.js:185).
why: At the start 60 of 80 units are free (sim), the network has Iberian and standard tramos, requests are generated (engine.js:245-256), and every instruction maps to an objective.
unifiedFix: Keep it as the first chapter. «Encargar 2 trenes» should count factory and used Trenespop lots. Add a deadline (the first election) with Gobierno trust consequences.

text: Querido presidente de Tenfe: hoy España elige. Elige YaIré, elige OuiOui, elige el autobús con un wifi que no funciona. Y yo quiero que elija Tenfe, porque Tenfe es España, y España, modestamente, soy yo. Pon más trenes, construye algún cambiador de ancho y deja de perder viajeros, que da mala imagen. Si sale bien, lo anuncio yo. Si sale mal, ya sabes dónde está la puerta.
claim: Passengers choose YaIré, OuiOui or the bus. Run more trains, build a gauge changer, stop losing passengers. If it goes badly, there is the door.
trigger: Campaign only. Shown on the Despacho story page while s.chapter=1 (storyPage app.js:959-967; free mode renders a different page). Spoken by its listen button, and automatically after claiming the previous chapter (app.js:1297). Objectives are evaluated by objectiveValue (engine.js:183). Claiming needs yearOf(s)>=2024 and every objective (chapterReady/claimChapter engine.js:184-185). There is no deadline and no failure state.
choiceEffects: No choices. Objectives (story.js:16): 20 active services, 260 daily trains, 1 changer built by the player (infra.done.changers, engine.js:183, 202), 62 % satisfaction, 4 trains delivered. Reward 180 M€.
why: The rivals and the bus exist and the objectives match the text, but there is no deadline or failure. «La puerta» only comes from Gobierno trust < 15 for 6 months (tycoon.js:165), which has nothing to do with this chapter. If chapter 1 is claimed early, this text can play in 2022, before YaIré exists.
unifiedFix: Give each chapter a deadline (the end of the legislature, i.e. the election week) and a consequence when missed: Gobierno trust −20 and a lower vote forecast. YaIré and OuiOui presence per corridor stays as rival state.

text: Te lo resumo en un tuit: corredor mediterráneo, ya. Bueno, ese «ya» lo llevamos diciendo treinta años. La demanda no entiende de anchos de vía; la vía, por desgracia, sí. Quiero un AVE de València a Barcelona y la alta velocidad en Almería. Pon tercer carril donde haga falta y no me cortes una cinta sin catenaria, que luego salen memes. Y si alguien te dice que esto se hace en dos años, bloquéalo.
claim: Mediterranean corridor: an AVE from València to Barcelona and high speed in Almería. Add third rail where needed. Never cut a ribbon without catenary.
trigger: Campaign only. Shown on the Despacho story page while s.chapter=2 (storyPage app.js:959-967; free mode renders a different page). Spoken by its listen button, and automatically after claiming the previous chapter (app.js:1297). Objectives are evaluated by objectiveValue (engine.js:183). Claiming needs yearOf(s)>=2028 and every objective (chapterReady/claimChapter engine.js:184-185). There is no deadline and no failure state.
choiceEffects: No choices. Objectives (story.js:17): mediterranean=2, meaning valencia-barcelona AVE is *possible* plus the almeria project is done (engine.js:183); 250 km converted to standard or mixed gauge; 26 active services. Reward 260 M€.
why: The AVE València–Barcelona objective counts route capability, not an AVE actually running. Today the only blocker is cas-tar (Iberian, 190 km; mixed gauge 103 M€ / 35 months, sim). «No me cortes una cinta sin catenaria» has no rule behind it (player-built lines are always 25 kV).
unifiedFix: The objective should be an AVE-family service actually running on València–Barcelona. Opening a new line without catenary should cost reputation. Make conversions voltage-aware: third rail on the 3 kV corridor needs 25 kV or dual-voltage trains.

text: Ha vuelto la España vaciada a los telediarios, así que toca acordarse de ella. Que sí, que Madrid y Barcelona dan dinero, pero Soria, Teruel y Extremadura también tienen urnas. Electrifica lo que siga con gasóleo, lleva el AVE a más ciudades y termina alguna línea nueva antes de que me jubile. Rentabilidad y servicio público pueden convivir, como los cuñados en Nochebuena: con esfuerzo y sin hablar de política.
claim: Empty Spain is back on the news, and Soria, Teruel and Extremadura vote too. Electrify what still runs on diesel, take the AVE to more cities, and finish some new line.
trigger: Campaign only. Shown on the Despacho story page while s.chapter=3 (storyPage app.js:959-967; free mode renders a different page). Spoken by its listen button, and automatically after claiming the previous chapter (app.js:1297). Objectives are evaluated by objectiveValue (engine.js:183). Claiming needs yearOf(s)>=2035 and every objective (chapterReady/claimChapter engine.js:184-185). There is no deadline and no failure state.
choiceEffects: No choices. Objectives (story.js:18): 300 km electrified by player works, AVE in 30 cities, 3 finished PROJECTS. Only type 'infrastructure' counts; lines built with buildLine are type 'custom' and do not (engine.js:183). Reward 350 M€.
why: The electrification target is reachable (1,940 km still without catenary after the 2023 history, sim). But «termina alguna línea nueva» ignores lines the player builds, and Soria, Teruel and Extremadura are not specifically required.
unifiedFix: Count player-built LAVs in 'projects'. Add sub-objectives «Soria, Teruel y Extremadura con catenaria» (trb-sor, zar-ter/ter-sag, mad-tal/tal-pla no longer 'no'), tied to Territorio trust and to votes in those provinces.

text: Llega la hora del legado, que es como llamamos los políticos a la foto final. Quiero AVE hasta en el último rincón con estación, trenes llenos y unas cuentas que no den vergüenza. A ti te juzgarán por la red que dejes. A mí me juzgará la Historia, que ya me la he leído y salgo estupendamente.
claim: AVE to every corner with a station, full trains, accounts that are not embarrassing. You will be judged by the network you leave.
trigger: Campaign only. Shown on the Despacho story page while s.chapter=4 (storyPage app.js:959-967; free mode renders a different page). Spoken by its listen button, and automatically after claiming the previous chapter (app.js:1297). Objectives are evaluated by objectiveValue (engine.js:183). choiceEffects: No choices. Objectives (story.js:19): 420 daily trains, AVE in 40 cities, 72 % satisfaction, more cash than debt. Reward 500 M€. The final score (engine.js:258) measures services, trains, AVE cities, satisfaction, net cash and chapters.
why: The objectives and the final score measure network size, AVE cities, satisfaction and solvency. Only «trenes llenos» (occupancy) is not measured.
unifiedFix: Keep it as the finale and add network occupancy ≥60 % as an objective. In a 2027–2034 timeline, map it to the final legislature (weeks 208–416).

text: Que OuiOui venda billetes a precio de pipas no te obliga a regalar el tren. Elige cómo plantarles cara.
claim: OuiOui selling tickets at peanut prices does not force you to give the train away. Choose how to stand up to them.
trigger: Spoken on every contract card whose q.arc=0 (contractHTML tycoon-ui.js:31-36: live contracts in Agenda tycoon-ui.js:73, closed ones in the history tycoon-ui.js:77). The face mood is worried, or proud/angry once won/lost. Arc of an offer: mission-0 uses campaign arc = s.chapter (tycoon.js:146); project offers use programme.arc ?? t.arc%5 (tycoon.js:69), arc 1 being swapped for arc 0 before the Pajares history (tycoon.js:70-71). Offers come every 6 months or after a resolution (tycoon.js:183). Route choice: chooseRoute (tycoon.js:55-63) prefers regions[0] (tycoon.js:54) but falls back to any feasible route (tycoon.js:60).
choiceEffects: Contract branches: public = open + frequency + fare ≤0.95× current at stage 1 (plus station or level at later stages); commercial = margin ≥8 % (12 % at stage 3) and occupancy ≥35 %. Reward 24/34/44 (public) or 34/46/60 (commercial) per stage (tycoon.js:75-107). Mission-0 is a passengers goal (tycoon.js:146). Nothing involves OuiOui.
why: In simulation the arc-0 project was Valencia–Alicante, with zero rivals. Mission-0 (a passengers goal) also speaks this line. OuiOui only serves Madrid routes before month 72 (tycoon.js:20-24), and no requirement mentions it, so the price war the text describes is absent from the contract.
unifiedFix: Arc-0 contracts must pick a corridor where OuiOui is present and preferably at war (competition(s,r).some(c=>c.id==='lowgo')). Requirements: keep share ≥X % against OuiOui with margin ≥0. Public branch: fare ≤ OuiOui fare + 10 %. Commercial branch: margin ≥8 % backed by quality. With no such corridor, do not offer arc 0.

text: El túnel está. Ahora faltan trenes, viajeros y alguien que deje de cortar cintas.
claim: The tunnel is there. Now trains, passengers and someone who stops cutting ribbons are missing.

Offers come every 6 months or after a resolution (tycoon.js:183). Route choice: chooseRoute (tycoon.js:55-63) prefers regions[1] (tycoon.js:54) but falls back to any feasible route (tycoon.js:60).
choiceEffects: Same project requirements as the other arcs; regions[1] = gij, ovi, san, leo, bil, pam, iru.
why: The arc is correctly gated on the Pajares opening. But the route can fall back to any region, and when arc 1 is swapped for arc 0 before the opening, the counter still advances on resolution (tycoon.js:176, 180), so the Pajares arc can be skipped entirely (sim: arcs 0 → 2 → 3).
unifiedFix: Require a route that uses tramo leo-pol (routeUses): Madrid–Gijón or Madrid–Oviedo. Queue arc 1 until Pajares opens instead of replacing it. Requirements: a variable-gauge Alvia service with ≥N departures and occupancy ≥50 %.

text:
Vamos con el Mediterráneo: el trazado lleva peor tus promesas que yo.

Deja de unir capitales en los discursos. Une estaciones en el mapa.

A non-Madrid route gets +8 in the score (tycoon.js:61).

unifiedFix: Choose among Mediterranean corridor relations (valencia-barcelona, valencia-alicante, murcia-almeria, madrid-cartagena). At stages 2–3 add an infrastructure requirement (cas-tar mixed gauge, or electrifying mur-car), so «une estaciones en el mapa» means building and opening.

text: Aquí también pagamos impuestos. El autobús de las seis ya nos conoce demasiado.
claim: We pay taxes here too. The six o'clock bus knows us far too well.
trigger: Spoken on every contract card whose q.arc=3 (contractHTML tycoon-ui.js:31-36: live contracts in Agenda tycoon-ui.js:73, closed ones in the history tycoon-ui.js:77). The face mood is worried, or proud/angry once won/lost. Offers come every 6 months or after a resolution (tycoon.js:183). Route choice: chooseRoute (tycoon.js:55-63) prefers regions[3] (tycoon.js:54) but falls back to any feasible route (tycoon.js:60).
choiceEffects: Project requirements; regions[3] = sal, bad, sor, lug, fer, avi, jae, hue, alg.
why: The rural preference works (sim: Madrid–Ávila), but the fallback can pick any route, and «el autobús de las seis» exists only through the generic bus share.
unifiedFix: Restrict arc 3 to rural or PSO cities. Requirements: a first departure before 07:00 (schedule first ≤420 min) or ≥2 departures a day, and the bus share falling below X %.

text: Se acercan las elecciones. Necesito resultados, no otra maqueta con luces.
claim: Elections are coming. I need results, not another model railway with lights.
trigger: Spoken on every contract card whose q.arc=4 (contractHTML tycoon-ui.js:31-36: live contracts in Agenda tycoon-ui.js:73, closed ones in the history tycoon-ui.js:77). The face mood is worried, or proud/angry once won/lost. Arc 4 appears whenever the counter reaches it, with no link to any election.

why: The classic engine has no elections; arc order is just a counter.
unifiedFix: Offer arc 4 only within 12 months of an election (Rescate ELECTIONS). The requirement is to inaugurate or complete something before election week; the reward is vote +2 and Gobierno trust +10.

text:
A ver, director: antes de las fotos toca decidir qué vas a proteger.

Elige qué protegerás primero: la caja, la cobertura o ambas. Enero de 2022; soy Raquel Sanz y tú diriges la empresa. Después prepararemos una jornada real, decisión por decisión. La inauguración absurda puede esperar; yo tengo experiencia.
claim: January 2022: before the photos, choose what you will protect first: cash, coverage or both. Then we will prepare a real working day, decision by decision.
trigger: Guided first turn (campaign, month 0). It starts after the inaugural decision (app.js:1296 → startTutorial app.js:413-421) and can be paused and resumed from Ayuda. Stage «mandate» briefing line 0: shown as a modal by renderCoach (app.js:488-500). It advances with tutorialNext (app.js:429-446); the stage gate is stageChecks (induction-runtime.js:77-93).

why: The date and the framing are true (month 0, and a real day follows), but «elige qué protegerás» leads to a quiz with no state, and it duplicates the inaugural policy decision.
unifiedFix: Store the answer as tycoon.priority (or reuse s.policy) and use it in contract offers (coverage offers the public branch first, margin the commercial one) and in advisor hints. If the unified game starts in 2027, «Enero de 2022» becomes obsolete: either keep the induction as a 2022 prologue or re-record.

text: Tu prioridad está elegida; la caja sigue igual. Antes de abrir servicios, comprueba qué tren admite la vía. Soy Íñigo Asfalto, de Autocares Meseta: en mi familia vasca llamamos oportunidad a los viajeros que un iluminado deja sin tren.

text: Charo Tijera. La caja paga inversiones, pero las frecuencias y las políticas también generan costes cada mes. Una línea rentable puede financiar otra necesaria. Antes de tocar nada, elige qué vas a proteger en este primer turno.

text:
Baje al plano, director: Salamanca necesita ruedas compatibles, no otro discurso.

Abre Madrid–Salamanca y lee «Qué puede circular». Consulta también sus anchos y electricidad. Soy Benito Balasto, Adif: un tren debe cumplir ambos requisitos en todo el recorrido. Pintar la línea de rojo no la convierte en alta velocidad, por mucho que vote el alcalde.

trigger: Guided first turn (campaign, month 0). It starts after the inaugural decision (app.js:1296 → startTutorial app.js:413-421) and can be paused and resumed from Ayuda. Stage «diagnosis» briefing line 0: shown as a modal by renderCoach (app.js:488-500). It advances with tutorialNext (app.js:429-446); the stage gate is stageChecks (induction-runtime.js:77-93). The map layer switches to 'gauge' (focusTutorial app.js:457-463).

unifiedFix: Keep, and add voltage (3 kV / 25 kV) as a requirement per train. The text says «electricidad» in general, so it stays true.

text: Salamanca admite un Alvia eléctrico mediante el cambiador existente: no necesita una obra para empezar. Soy Paco Terruño, alcalde. Antes de prometer otro túnel, asigne un tren compatible. Nos ahorraríamos veinte años y una colección de ministros con tijeras.

text:
Vamos con València: las salidas extra también pasan por mi calculadora.

En Madrid–València, aumenta al menos una salida por sentido y cambia la tarifa. Mira beneficio, ocupación y unidades antes de aplicar el plan. Más trenes cuestan dinero; rebajar billetes a ciegas no es gestión, es subvencionar tu propia ocurrencia.

text:
Llega la hora de firmar, director; la foto sola no cobra el premio.

Lee el encargo de Agenda y acepta la rama que puedas cumplir. Servicio público exige menos; la apuesta comercial paga más y exige un 25 % adicional. El plazo es de dieciocho meses. El premio llega al cumplir, no al prometer; una crueldad que en política evitamos.
claim: Read the Agenda commission and accept the branch you can meet. Public service demands less; the commercial bet pays more and demands 25 % more. The deadline is eighteen months, and the prize comes on completion.

Stage «handoff» briefing line 0: shown as a modal by renderCoach (app.js:488-500). It advances with tutorialNext (app.js:429-446); the stage gate is stageChecks (induction-runtime.js:77-93). inductionBriefing shows the 3 lines only for the month-0 passengers contract mission-0; otherwise only line 2 (induction-runtime.js:34-38).
choiceEffects: Accepting: target = max(250000, last.passengers×5) = 250,000 new passengers, until month 18 (tycoon.js:146). Commercial: ×1.25 → 312,500, reward 26, penalty 8. Public: reward 18, penalty 5 (tycoon.js:154). Win: +6 trust to Territorio or Hacienda (tycoon.js:177).
why: The numbers are literally right, but the starting network already carries 525,786 passengers a month (sim), so both branches are won at the first month close. «Exige más» and the 18-month deadline carry no risk, and the commercial branch is strictly better.
unifiedFix: Set the first contract target as growth over the organic forecast, e.g. +8 % passengers on named corridors versus the forecast, or 250,000 passengers above the baseline trend. The commercial +25 % should then require extra departures or units.

Servicio público paga dieciocho millones si cumples y favorece a Territorio. La apuesta comercial paga veintiséis, exige un veinticinco por ciento más y favorece a Hacienda. El premio se cobra al cumplir; el botón de aceptar no imprime billetes.
